layer1.name: Senja
layer1.one_liner: Collect video and text testimonials and publish them anywhere.
layer1.description: Customers record a testimonial through a link; the product turns them into embeddable walls, widgets and images. Two founders who met online, building in public from zero.
layer1.outcome_note: Bootstrapped from $0 to over $1M ARR (roughly $83k MRR) with more than 3,000 customers and no investors. The founders published each revenue milestone as they hit it.
